import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class FireModule(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.reduce = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_a = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_b = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.squeeze_activation = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.expand1x1_activation = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.expand3x3_activation = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.squeeze_activation(self.reduce(x))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.expand1x1_activation(self.expand_a(x)), self.expand3x3_activation(self.expand_b(x))], 1
        )

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class SkipBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut=None, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv1 = make_conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv2 = make_conv3(planes, planes)
        self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, feats):
        identity = feats

        y = self.conv1(feats)
        y = self.bn1(y)
        y = self.relu(y)
        y = self.conv2(y)
        y = self.bn2(y)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            identity = self.shortcut(feats)

        y += identity
        y = self.relu(y)
        return y

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def channel_shuffle(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super(ShuffleBlock, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(x), self.branch2(x)), dim=1)
        out = channel_shuffle(out, 2)
        return out

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class FeedForward(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class TransformerLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = FeedForward(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.dim() == 3, f"Expected (batch_size, seq_length, hidden_dim) got {x.shape}")
        h = self.ln_1(x)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + x

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y

class FireModule(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.squeeze = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand1x1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand3x3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.SiLU()

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        inp = self.act(self.squeeze(inp))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.act(self.expand1x1(inp)), self.act(self.expand3x3(inp))], 1
        )

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResUnit(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut: Optional[nn.Module] = None, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super(ResUnit, self).__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv_a = conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_b = conv3(planes, planes)
        self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        shortcut_out = feats

        y = self.conv_a(feats)
        y = self.bn1(y)
        y = F.silu(y, inplace=True)
        y = self.conv_b(y)
        y = self.bn2(y)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            shortcut_out = self.shortcut(feats)

        y += shortcut_out
        y = F.silu(y, inplace=True)
        return y

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResUnit(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut=None, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv_a = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_b = conv3x3(planes, planes)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, input):
        skip_val = input

        out = self.conv_a(input)
        out = self.norm1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv_b(out)
        out = self.norm2(out)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            skip_val = self.shortcut(input)

        out += skip_val
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class ConvNormAct(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act
        self.act = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        if self.use_act:
            x = self.act(x)
        return x


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, ch4):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = ConvNormAct(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = ConvNormAct(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = ConvNormAct(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch2_3 = ConvNormAct(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch3_1 = ConvNormAct(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = ConvNormAct(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(1, 7))
        self.branch4_1 = ConvNormAct(in_channels, ch4, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch4_2 = ConvNormAct(ch4, ch4, kernel_size=(1, 7))
        self.branch4_3 = ConvNormAct(ch4, ch4, kernel_size=(7, 1))

    def _forward(self, x: Tensor):
        br1 = self.branch1(x)
        br2 = self.branch2_1(x)
        br2 = self.branch2_2(br2)
        br2 = self.branch2_3(br2)
        br3 = self.branch3_1(x)
        br3 = self.branch3_2(br3)
        br4 = self.branch4_1(x)
        br4 = self.branch4_2(br4)
        br4 = self.branch4_3(br4)
        return [br1, br2, br3, br4]

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = self._forward(x)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

import torch

def shuffle_channels(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super(ShuffleResidual, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                self.dw_conv(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            self.dw_conv(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def dw_conv(i, o, kernel_size, stride=1, padding=0, bias=False) -> nn.Conv2d:
        return nn.Conv2d(i, o, kernel_size, stride, padding, bias=bias, groups=i)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = z.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(z), self.branch2(z)), dim=1)
        out = shuffle_channels(out, 2)
        return out

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class ConvBN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.act = nn.ReLU6()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return self.act(x)


class InceptionA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features, conv_block=None):
        super().__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = ConvBN
        self.branch1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3), padding=(0, 1))
        self.branch2_3 = conv_block(ch2 * 2, ch2, kernel_size=(3, 1), padding=(1, 0))
        self.branch_pool = conv_block(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, x):
        b1 = self.branch1(x)
        b2 = self.branch2_1(x)
        b2 = self.branch2_2(b2)
        b2 = self.branch2_3(b2)
        bp = F.max_pool2d(x, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [b1, b2, bp]

    def forward(self, x):
        outputs = self._forward(x)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels, eps=0.001)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.conv(z)
        z = self.bn(z)
        return F.relu(z, inplace=True)


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, z):
        scale = self.avgpool(z)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * z


class MobileBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(BasicConv2d(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(BasicConv2d(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SELayer(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, z):
        out = self.conv(z)
        if self.residual:
            out = out + z
        return out

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBNReLU(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super(ConvBNReLU, self).__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        inp = self.conv(inp)
        inp = self.bn(inp)
        if not self.use_act:
            return inp
        return F.relu(inp, inplace=True)


class InvertedResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio):
        super(InvertedResidual, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(ConvBNReLU(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvBNReLU(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=5, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))

        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv(inp)
        if self.residual:
            out = out + inp
        return out

class FireModule(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.sq = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.squeeze_activation = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.expand1x1_activation = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.expand3x3_activation = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        input = self.squeeze_activation(self.sq(input))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.expand1x1_activation(self.ex1(input)), self.expand3x3_activation(self.ex3(input))], 1
        )

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super(ConvBlock, self).__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act
        self.act = nn.ReLU6(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        z = self.conv(z)
        z = self.bn(z)
        if self.use_act:
            z = self.act(z)
        return z


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features, conv_block: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super(InceptionBlock, self).__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = ConvBlock
        self.branch_a = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = conv_block(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, z: Tensor):
        y1 = self.branch_a(z)
        b2 = self.branch_b_1(z)
        b2 = self.branch_b_2(b2)
        bp = self.pool(z)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [y1, b2, bp]

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = self._forward(z)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class ConvBN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        inp = self.conv(inp)
        inp = self.bn(inp)
        return self.act(inp)


class MixedBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch_a = ConvBN(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = ConvBN(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = ConvBN(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=5, padding=2)
        self.branch_b_3 = ConvBN(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=5, padding=2)
        self.branch_pool = ConvBN(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        br1 = self.branch_a(inp)
        br2 = self.branch_b_1(inp)
        br2 = self.branch_b_2(br2)
        br2 = self.branch_b_3(br2)
        bp = F.avg_pool2d(inp, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([br1, br2, bp], dim=1)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class BottleneckBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj: Optional[nn.Module] = None, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv_a = conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_b = conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_c = conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.norm3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.relu3 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        skip_val = x

        out = self.conv_a(x)
        out = self.norm1(out)
        out = self.relu1(out)
        out = self.conv_b(out)
        out = self.norm2(out)
        out = self.relu2(out)
        out = self.conv_c(out)
        out = self.norm3(out)

        if self.proj is not None:
            skip_val = self.proj(x)

        out = out + skip_val
        out = self.relu3(out)
        return out

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResBottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = make_conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = make_conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c3 = make_conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * self.expansion)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, input):
        shortcut_out = input

        h = self.c1(input)
        h = self.bn1(h)
        h = F.silu(h)
        h = self.c2(h)
        h = self.bn2(h)
        h = F.silu(h)
        h = self.c3(h)
        h = self.bn3(h)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            shortcut_out = self.shortcut(input)

        h += shortcut_out
        h = F.silu(h)
        return h

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def channel_shuffle(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super(ShuffleBlock, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, z):
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = z.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(z), self.branch2(z)), dim=1)
        out = channel_shuffle(out, 2)
        return out

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def conv_bn_act(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
    padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
    layers = [
        nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding,
                  groups=groups, bias=False),
        nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
    ]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.ReLU6(inplace=True))
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)


class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Hardsigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        scale = self.avgpool(x)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * x


class InvertedBottleneck(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.use_residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(conv_bn_act(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(conv_bn_act(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=5, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SEBlock(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.conv(x)
        if self.use_residual:
            out = out + x
        return out

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class BottleneckBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj=None):
        super(BottleneckBlock, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = make_conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv2 = make_conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv3 = make_conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.norm3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * self.expansion)
        self.relu1 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.relu3 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, z):
        residual = z

        y = self.conv1(z)
        y = self.norm1(y)
        y = self.relu1(y)
        y = self.conv2(y)
        y = self.norm2(y)
        y = self.relu2(y)
        y = self.conv3(y)
        y = self.norm3(y)

        if self.proj is not None:
            residual = self.proj(z)

        y += residual
        y = self.relu3(y)
        return y

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class Bottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj: Optional[nn.Module] = None, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv_a = conv1x1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_b = conv3x3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_c = conv1x1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        skip_val = z

        y = self.conv_a(z)
        y = self.bn1(y)
        y = self.relu(y)
        y = self.conv_b(y)
        y = self.bn2(y)
        y = self.relu(y)
        y = self.conv_c(y)
        y = self.bn3(y)

        if self.proj is not None:
            skip_val = self.proj(z)

        y += skip_val
        y = self.relu(y)
        return y

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class BasicConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return F.relu(x, inplace=True)


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = BasicConv(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = BasicConv(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = BasicConv(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1), padding=(1, 0))
        self.branch2_3 = BasicConv(ch2 * 2, ch2, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.branch3_1 = BasicConv(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = BasicConv(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=5, padding=2)
        self.branch3_3 = BasicConv(ch3 * 2, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3), padding=(0, 1))
        self.branch_pool = BasicConv(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        y1 = self.branch1(x)
        y2 = self.branch2_1(x)
        y2 = self.branch2_2(y2)
        y2 = self.branch2_3(y2)
        y3 = self.branch3_1(x)
        y3 = self.branch3_2(y3)
        y3 = self.branch3_3(y3)
        bp = F.avg_pool2d(x, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([y1, y2, y3, bp], dim=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class MLP(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class TransformerLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super(TransformerLayer, self).__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLP(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, inp):
        torch._assert(inp.dim() == 3, f"Expected (batch_size, seq_length, hidden_dim) got {inp.shape}")
        h, _ = self.self_attention(inp, inp, inp, need_weights=False)
        h = self.ln_1(self.dropout(h) + inp)
        y = self.mlp(h)
        return self.ln_2(h + y)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class BasicConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs: Any):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return F.hardswish(x, inplace=True)


class InceptionA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = BasicConv(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = BasicConv(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = BasicConv(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 7), padding=(0, 3))
        self.branch2_3 = BasicConv(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(7, 1), padding=(3, 0))
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = BasicConv(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, x: Tensor):
        br1 = self.branch1(x)
        y2 = self.branch2_1(x)
        y2 = self.branch2_2(y2)
        y2 = self.branch2_3(y2)
        bp = self.pool(x)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [br1, y2, bp]

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = self._forward(x)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def conv_bn_act(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
    padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
    layers = [
        nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding,
                  groups=groups, bias=False),
        nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
    ]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.ReLU6(inplace=True))
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)


class SqueezeExcitation(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        scale = self.avgpool(x)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * x


class InvertedResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(conv_bn_act(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(conv_bn_act(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SqueezeExcitation(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv(x)
        if self.residual:
            out = out + x
        return out

class FireModule(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.squeeze = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)

        input = self.act(self.squeeze(input))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.act(self.expand1x1(input)), self.act(self.expand3x3(input))], 1
        )

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBNAct(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, groups=groups, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
        ]
        if act:
            layers.append(nn.Hardswish())
        super().__init__(*layers)


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch_a = ConvBNAct(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = ConvBNAct(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = ConvBNAct(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 7))
        self.branch_b_3 = ConvBNAct(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(7, 1))
        self.branch_c_1 = ConvBNAct(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_c_2 = ConvBNAct(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch_c_3 = ConvBNAct(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = ConvBNAct(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        y1 = self.branch_a(tensor)
        b2 = self.branch_b_1(tensor)
        b2 = self.branch_b_2(b2)
        b2 = self.branch_b_3(b2)
        b3 = self.branch_c_1(tensor)
        b3 = self.branch_c_2(b3)
        b3 = self.branch_c_3(b3)
        bp = self.pool(tensor)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([y1, b2, b3, bp], dim=1)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu1 = nn.Hardswish()
        self.relu2 = nn.Hardswish()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(self.relu1(self.norm1(z)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu2(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class _DenseBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        features = [z]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(features, 1))
            features.append(new)
        return torch.cat(features, 1)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def channel_shuffle(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = inp.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(inp), self.branch2(inp)), dim=1)
        out = channel_shuffle(out, 2)
        return out

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResUnit(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, skip: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU6(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU6(inplace=True)
        self.skip = skip
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        shortcut_out = x

        h = self.conv1(x)
        h = self.bn1(h)
        h = self.relu1(h)
        h = self.conv2(h)
        h = self.bn2(h)

        if self.skip is not None:
            shortcut_out = self.skip(x)

        h += shortcut_out
        h = self.relu2(h)
        return h

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class MLPBlock(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class TransformerLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLPBlock(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        h = self.ln_1(tensor)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + tensor

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class BasicConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels, eps=0.001)
        self.act = nn.Hardswish()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return self.act(x)


class Inception(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = BasicConv(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = BasicConv(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = BasicConv(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=5, padding=2)
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = BasicConv(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, x):
        b1 = self.branch1(x)
        y2 = self.branch2_1(x)
        y2 = self.branch2_2(y2)
        bp = self.pool(x)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [b1, y2, bp]

    def forward(self, x):
        outputs = self._forward(x)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

class MLP(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):

def conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):

def conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn_a = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = conv3(planes, planes)
        self.bn_b = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        residual = x

        h = self.c1(x)
        h = self.bn_a(h)
        h = F.silu(h)
        h = self.c2(h)
        h = self.bn_b(h)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            residual = self.shortcut(x)

        h += residual
        h = F.silu(h)
        return h

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Conv2dBNAct(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, groups=groups, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
        ]
        if act:
            layers.append(nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        super(Conv2dBNAct, self).__init__(*layers)


class InceptionA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features, conv_block=None):
        super(InceptionA, self).__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = Conv2dBNAct
        self.branch1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 7))
        self.branch2_3a = conv_block(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch2_3b = conv_block(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch_pool = conv_block(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, feats):
        y1 = self.branch1(feats)
        y2 = self.branch2_1(feats)
        y2 = self.branch2_2(y2)
        y2 = [
            self.branch2_3a(y2),
            self.branch2_3b(y2),
        ]
        y2 = torch.cat(y2, 1)
        bp = F.max_pool2d(feats, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([y1, y2, bp], dim=1)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class _DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super(_DenseLayer, self).__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(x)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class DenseStage(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super(DenseStage, self).__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [_DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        feats_list = [x]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(feats_list, 1))
            feats_list.append(new)
        return torch.cat(feats_list, 1)

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class MLPBlock(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLPBlock(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, z):
        h = self.ln_1(z)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + z

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class SkipBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class MLPBlock(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class EncoderLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLPBlock(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        h = self.ln_1(x)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + x

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act
        self.act = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, input):
        input = self.conv(input)
        input = self.bn(input)
        if self.use_act:
            input = self.act(input)
        return input


class MobileBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.use_res_connect = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(BasicConv2d(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(BasicConv2d(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))

        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, input):
        if self.use_res_connect:
            return input + self.conv(input)
        return self.conv(input)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return self.act(x)


class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        scale = self.avgpool(x)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * x


class InvertedResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.has_skip = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(BasicConv2d(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(BasicConv2d(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SEBlock(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.has_skip:
            return x + self.conv(x)
        return self.conv(x)

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def shuffle_channels(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super(ShuffleResidual, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                self.depthwise_conv(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            self.depthwise_conv(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def depthwise_conv(i, o, kernel_size, stride=1, padding=0, bias=False):
        return nn.Conv2d(i, o, kernel_size, stride, padding, bias=bias, groups=i)

    def forward(self, inp):
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = inp.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(inp), self.branch2(inp)), dim=1)
        out = shuffle_channels(out, 2)
        return out

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, downsample: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = make_conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = make_conv3(planes, planes)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.downsample = downsample
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        skip_val = tensor

        y = self.c1(tensor)
        y = self.norm1(y)
        y = F.relu(y, inplace=True)
        y = self.c2(y)
        y = self.norm2(y)

        if self.downsample is not None:
            skip_val = self.downsample(tensor)

        y += skip_val
        y = F.relu(y, inplace=True)
        return y

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBNAct(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, groups=groups, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
        ]
        if act:
            layers.append(nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        super().__init__(*layers)


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, conv_block: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = ConvBNAct
        self.branch1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2a = conv_block(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch2_2b = conv_block(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch3_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = conv_block(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 7))

    def _forward(self, x: Tensor):
        b1 = self.branch1(x)
        b2 = self.branch2_1(x)
        b2 = [
            self.branch2_2a(b2),
            self.branch2_2b(b2),
        ]
        b2 = torch.cat(b2, 1)
        br3 = self.branch3_1(x)
        br3 = self.branch3_2(br3)
        return [b1, b2, br3]

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = self._forward(x)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def channel_shuffle(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(x), self.branch2(x)), dim=1)
        out = channel_shuffle(out, 2)
        return out

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels, eps=0.001)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.conv(feats)
        feats = self.bn(feats)
        return self.act(feats)


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = BasicConv2d(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(3, 1), padding=(1, 0))
        self.branch3_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = BasicConv2d(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(7, 1), padding=(3, 0))
        self.branch_pool = BasicConv2d(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, feats):
        br1 = self.branch1(feats)
        b2 = self.branch2_1(feats)
        b2 = self.branch2_2(b2)
        br3 = self.branch3_1(feats)
        br3 = self.branch3_2(br3)
        bp = F.avg_pool2d(feats, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([br1, b2, br3, bp], dim=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResBottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj=None):
        super(ResBottleneck, self).__init__()
        self.c1 = conv1x1(inplanes, planes)
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = conv3x3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c3 = conv1x1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.norm3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * self.expansion)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.relu3 = nn.ReLU()
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, z):
        skip_val = z

        out = self.c1(z)
        out = self.norm1(out)
        out = self.relu1(out)
        out = self.c2(out)
        out = self.norm2(out)
        out = self.relu2(out)
        out = self.c3(out)
        out = self.norm3(out)

        if self.proj is not None:
            skip_val = self.proj(z)

        out = out + skip_val
        out = self.relu3(out)
        return out

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super(BasicBlock, self).__init__()
        self.conv_a = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv_b = conv3x3(planes, planes)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        residual = tensor

        y = self.conv_a(tensor)
        y = self.bn1(y)
        y = self.relu(y)
        y = self.conv_b(y)
        y = self.bn2(y)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            residual = self.shortcut(tensor)

        y = y + residual
        y = self.relu(y)
        return y

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def shuffle_channels(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(x), self.branch2(x)), dim=1)
        out = shuffle_channels(out, 2)
        return out

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = make_conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = make_conv3(planes, planes)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.relu1 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x

        h = self.c1(x)
        h = self.norm1(h)
        h = self.relu1(h)
        h = self.c2(h)
        h = self.norm2(h)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            residual = self.shortcut(x)

        h += residual
        h = self.relu2(h)
        return h

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Conv2dBNAct(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, groups=groups, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
        ]
        if act:
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
        super(Conv2dBNAct, self).__init__(*layers)


class SqueezeExcitation(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super(SqueezeExcitation, self).__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Hardsigmoid()

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        scale = self.avgpool(input)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * input


class MBConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super(MBConv, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.use_res_connect = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(Conv2dBNAct(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(Conv2dBNAct(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SqueezeExcitation(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv(input)
        if self.use_res_connect:
            out = out + input
        return out

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv_bn(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
    padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
    layers = [
        nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding,
                  groups=groups, bias=False),
        nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
    ]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.SiLU())
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, ch4, conv_block: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = conv_bn
        self.branch1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2a = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch2_2b = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch3_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2a = conv_block(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch3_2b = conv_block(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch4_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch4, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch4_2 = conv_block(ch4, ch4, kernel_size=5)
        self.branch4_3 = conv_block(ch4, ch4, kernel_size=3)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        y1 = self.branch1(z)
        br2 = self.branch2_1(z)
        br2 = [
            self.branch2_2a(br2),
            self.branch2_2b(br2),
        ]
        br2 = torch.cat(br2, 1)
        br3 = self.branch3_1(z)
        br3 = [
            self.branch3_2a(br3),
            self.branch3_2b(br3),
        ]
        br3 = torch.cat(br3, 1)
        y4 = self.branch4_1(z)
        y4 = self.branch4_2(y4)
        y4 = self.branch4_3(y4)
        return torch.cat([y1, br2, br3, y4], dim=1)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBNReLU(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super(ConvBNReLU, self).__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.act = nn.SiLU(inplace=True) if act else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return self.act(x)


class MobileBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio):
        super(MobileBlock, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.has_skip = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(ConvBNReLU(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvBNReLU(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))

        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv(x)
        if self.has_skip:
            out = out + x
        return out

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class Fire(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.squeeze = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand1x1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand3x3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.act(self.squeeze(feats))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.act(self.expand1x1(feats)), self.act(self.expand3x3(feats))], 1
        )

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class FeedForward(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super(EncoderBlock, self).__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = FeedForward(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        h = self.ln_1(input)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + input

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y

    ]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.SiLU())
