import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class FireModule(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.reduce = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_a = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_b = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.ReLU6()

    def forward(self, tensor):
        tensor = self.act(self.reduce(tensor))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.act(self.expand_a(tensor)), self.act(self.expand_b(tensor))], 1
        )


class FireNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            FireModule(32, 16, 64, 64),
            FireModule(128, 16, 64, 64),
            FireModule(128, 32, 128, 128),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            FireModule(256, 32, 128, 128),
            FireModule(256, 64, 256, 256),
            FireModule(512, 64, 256, 256),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            FireModule(512, 64, 256, 256),
            FireModule(512, 64, 256, 256),
        )
        final_conv = nn.Conv2d(512, num_classes, kernel_size=1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5), final_conv, nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        )

    def forward(self, tensor):
        tensor = self.features(tensor)
        tensor = self.classifier(tensor)
        return torch.flatten(tensor, 1)


net = FireNet()

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class DenseUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(z)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class _DenseBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseUnit(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        feats_list = [z]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(feats_list, 1))
            feats_list.append(new)
        return torch.cat(feats_list, 1)


class TinyDenseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(16)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = _DenseBlock(4, 16, 4, 8)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(48), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(48, 24, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = _DenseBlock(3, 24, 4, 8)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(48)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(48, num_classes)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        z = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(z)))
        z = self.denseblock1(z)
        z = self.transition1(z)
        z = self.denseblock2(z)
        z = F.relu(self.norm_final(z))
        z = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(z, (1, 1))
        z = torch.flatten(z, 1)
        return self.classifier(z)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class SqueezeExpand(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.reduce = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_a = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_b = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.act(self.reduce(x))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.act(self.expand_a(x)), self.act(self.expand_b(x))], 1
        )


class SqueezeNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            SqueezeExpand(64, 16, 64, 64),
            SqueezeExpand(128, 16, 64, 64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            SqueezeExpand(128, 32, 128, 128),
            SqueezeExpand(256, 32, 128, 128),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            SqueezeExpand(256, 64, 256, 256),
        )
        final_conv = nn.Conv2d(512, num_classes, kernel_size=1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5), final_conv, nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.features(x)
        x = self.classifier(x)
        return torch.flatten(x, 1)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResBottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj: Optional[nn.Module] = None, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv_a = conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_b = conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_c = conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        shortcut_out = z

        out = self.conv_a(z)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = torch.relu(out)
        out = self.conv_b(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out = F.relu(out)
        out = self.conv_c(out)
        out = self.bn3(out)

        if self.proj is not None:
            shortcut_out = self.proj(z)

        out = out + shortcut_out
        out = torch.relu(out)
        return out


class Backbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, block, num_classes=1000):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = 8
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, self.inplanes, kernel_size=5, stride=2, padding=2, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(self.inplanes)
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.layer1 = self._make_layer(block, 8, 1)
        self.layer2 = self._make_layer(block, 16, 1, stride=2)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(16 * block.expansion, num_classes)

    def _make_layer(self, block, planes, blocks, stride=1):
        downsample = None
        if stride != 1 or self.inplanes != planes * block.expansion:
            downsample = nn.Sequential(
                conv1(self.inplanes, planes * block.expansion, stride),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * block.expansion),
            )
        layers = [block(self.inplanes, planes, stride, downsample)]
        self.inplanes = planes * block.expansion
        for _ in range(1, blocks):
            layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes))
        return nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        z = self.conv1(z)
        z = self.bn1(z)
        z = torch.relu(z)
        z = self.maxpool(z)
        z = self.layer1(z)
        z = self.layer2(z)
        z = self.avgpool(z)
        z = z.flatten(1)
        z = self.fc(z)
        return z

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def shuffle_channels(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                self.dw_conv(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            self.dw_conv(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def dw_conv(i, o, kernel_size, stride=1, padding=0, bias=False):
        return nn.Conv2d(i, o, kernel_size, stride, padding, bias=bias, groups=i)

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(x), self.branch2(x)), dim=1)
        out = shuffle_channels(out, 2)
        return out


class ShuffleNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=1000):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(3, 24, 3, 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(24), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        input_channels = 24

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class ConvBN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.act = nn.ReLU6()

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return self.act(x)


class SqueezeExcitation(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        scale = self.avgpool(x)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * x


class MBConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.use_res_connect = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(ConvBN(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvBN(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SqueezeExcitation(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.use_res_connect:
            return x + self.conv(x)
        return self.conv(x)


class MobileNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        input_channel = 24
        settings = [
            [1, 12, 1, 1, False],
            [6, 12, 1, 1, False],
            [3, 12, 1, 2, False],
            [6, 20, 2, 2, False],
            [3, 20, 3, 2, False],
        ]
        features = [ConvBN(3, input_channel, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)]
        for t, c, n, s, se in settings:
            for i in range(n):
                stride = s if i == 0 else 1
                features.append(MBConv(input_channel, c, stride, expand_ratio=t, use_se=se))
                input_channel = c
        features.append(ConvBN(input_channel, 128, kernel_size=1))
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*features)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.features(x)
        x = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, 1)
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        x = self.classifier(x)
        return x

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class SkipBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj: Optional[nn.Module] = None, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv_a = conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn_a = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_b = conv3(planes, planes)
        self.bn_b = norm_layer(planes)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        residual = z

        h = self.conv_a(z)
        h = self.bn_a(h)
        h = torch.relu(h)
        h = self.conv_b(h)
        h = self.bn_b(h)

        if self.proj is not None:
            residual = self.proj(z)

        h += residual
        h = F.relu(h, inplace=True)
        return h


class ResNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, block, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = 8
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, self.inplanes, kernel_size=5, stride=2, padding=2, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(self.inplanes)
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.stage1 = self._make_layer(block, 8, 2)
        self.stage2 = self._make_layer(block, 16, 2, stride=2)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(16 * block.expansion, num_classes)

    def _make_layer(self, block, planes, blocks, stride=1):
        downsample = None
        if stride != 1 or self.inplanes != planes * block.expansion:
            downsample = nn.Sequential(
                conv1(self.inplanes, planes * block.expansion, stride),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * block.expansion),
            )
        layers = [block(self.inplanes, planes, stride, downsample)]
        self.inplanes = planes * block.expansion
        for _ in range(1, blocks):
            layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes))
        return nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        z = self.conv1(z)
        z = self.bn1(z)
        z = F.relu(z, inplace=True)
        z = self.maxpool(z)
        z = self.stage1(z)
        z = self.stage2(z)
        z = self.avgpool(z)
        z = z.flatten(1)
        z = self.fc(z)
        return z

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(x)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class DenseBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        features = [x]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(features, 1))
            features.append(new)
        return torch.cat(features, 1)


class DenseNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(24)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = DenseBlock(3, 24, 4, 12)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(60), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(60, 30, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = DenseBlock(4, 30, 4, 12)
        self.transition2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(78), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(78, 39, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock3 = DenseBlock(3, 39, 4, 12)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(75)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(75, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(x)))
        x = self.denseblock1(x)
        x = self.transition1(x)
        x = self.denseblock2(x)
        x = self.transition2(x)
        x = self.denseblock3(x)
        x = F.relu(self.norm_final(x))
        x = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, (1, 1))
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        return self.classifier(x)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(feats)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class DenseBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = [feats]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(outputs, 1))
            outputs.append(new)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)


class DenseBackbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(16)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = DenseBlock(4, 16, 2, 8)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(48), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(48, 24, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = DenseBlock(2, 24, 2, 8)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(40)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(40, num_classes)

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        feats = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(feats)))
        feats = self.denseblock1(feats)
        feats = self.transition1(feats)
        feats = self.denseblock2(feats)
        feats = F.relu(self.norm_final(feats))
        feats = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(feats, (1, 1))
        feats = torch.flatten(feats, 1)
        return self.classifier(feats)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class MLPBlock(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class EncoderLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super(EncoderLayer, self).__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLPBlock(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        torch._assert(z.dim() == 3, f"Expected (batch_size, seq_length, hidden_dim) got {z.shape}")
        h = self.ln_1(z)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + z

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y


class TinyViT(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super(TinyViT, self).__init__()
        self.conv_proj = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=8, stride=8)
        self.pos_embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 16, 16))
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            EncoderLayer(2, 16, 32),
            EncoderLayer(2, 16, 32),
        )
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(16, eps=1e-6)
        self.head = nn.Linear(16, num_classes)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv_proj(z)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + self.pos_embedding
        x = self.encoder(x)
        x = self.ln(x)
        x = x.mean(dim=1)
        return self.head(x)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class ConvBN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return F.hardswish(x)


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Hardsigmoid()

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        scale = self.avgpool(x)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * x


class InvertedResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.has_skip = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(ConvBN(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvBN(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=5, stride=stride, padding=2, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SELayer(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv(x)
        if self.has_skip:
            out = out + x
        return out


class MobileNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=1000):
        super().__init__()
        input_channel = 16
        settings = [
            [1, 8, 1, 1, True],
            [4, 16, 2, 2, False],
            [6, 32, 1, 2, False],
            [3, 64, 2, 2, False],
        ]
        features = [ConvBN(3, input_channel, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)]
        for t, c, n, s, se in settings:
            for i in range(n):
                stride = s if i == 0 else 1
                features.append(InvertedResidual(input_channel, c, stride, expand_ratio=t, use_se=se))
                input_channel = c
        features.append(ConvBN(input_channel, 128, kernel_size=1))
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*features)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.features(x)
        x = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, 1)
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        x = self.classifier(x)
        return x

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def shuffle_channels(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                self.depthwise_conv(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            self.depthwise_conv(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def depthwise_conv(i, o, kernel_size, stride=1, padding=0, bias=False):
        return nn.Conv2d(i, o, kernel_size, stride, padding, bias=bias, groups=i)

    def forward(self, input):
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = input.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(input), self.branch2(input)), dim=1)
        out = shuffle_channels(out, 2)
        return out


class ShuffleBackbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(3, 24, 3, 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(24), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        input_channels = 24
        seq = [ShuffleResidual(input_channels, 48, 2)]
        for _ in range(1):
            seq.append(ShuffleResidual(48, 48, 1))
        self.stage2 = nn.Sequential(*seq)
        input_channels = 48
        seq = [ShuffleResidual(input_channels, 96, 2)]
        for _ in range(0):
            seq.append(ShuffleResidual(96, 96, 1))
        self.stage3 = nn.Sequential(*seq)
        input_channels = 96
        self.conv5 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 256, 1, 1, 0, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(256), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(256, num_classes)

    def forward(self, input):
        input = self.conv1(input)
        input = self.maxpool(input)
        input = self.stage2(input)
        input = self.stage3(input)
        input = self.conv5(input)
        input = input.mean([2, 3])
        input = self.fc(input)
        return input

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class BottleneckBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut=None, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.c1 = make_conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.c2 = make_conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.c3 = make_conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
        self.relu1 = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.relu3 = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, inp):
        skip_val = inp

        h = self.c1(inp)
        h = self.bn1(h)
        h = self.relu1(h)
        h = self.c2(h)
        h = self.bn2(h)
        h = self.relu2(h)
        h = self.c3(h)
        h = self.bn3(h)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            skip_val = self.shortcut(inp)

        h += skip_val
        h = self.relu3(h)
        return h


class Backbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, block, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = 16
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, self.inplanes, kernel_size=5, stride=2, padding=2, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(self.inplanes)
        self.relu1 = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.stage1 = self._make_layer(block, 16, 2)
        self.stage2 = self._make_layer(block, 32, 1, stride=2)
        self.stage3 = self._make_layer(block, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(64 * block.expansion, num_classes)

    def _make_layer(self, block, planes, blocks, stride=1):
        downsample = None
        if stride != 1 or self.inplanes != planes * block.expansion:
            downsample = nn.Sequential(
                make_conv1(self.inplanes, planes * block.expansion, stride),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * block.expansion),
            )
        layers = [block(self.inplanes, planes, stride, downsample)]
        self.inplanes = planes * block.expansion
        for _ in range(1, blocks):
            layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes))
        return nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, inp):
        inp = self.conv1(inp)
        inp = self.bn1(inp)
        inp = self.relu1(inp)
        inp = self.maxpool(inp)
        inp = self.stage1(inp)
        inp = self.stage2(inp)
        inp = self.stage3(inp)
        inp = self.avgpool(inp)
        inp = torch.flatten(inp, 1)
        inp = self.fc(inp)
        return inp

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class DenseUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super(DenseUnit, self).__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU6()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(input)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class DenseStage(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super(DenseStage, self).__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseUnit(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        feats_list = [input]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(feats_list, 1))
            feats_list.append(new)
        return torch.cat(feats_list, 1)


class DenseBackbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super(DenseBackbone, self).__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(24)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = DenseStage(4, 24, 4, 12)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(72), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(72, 36, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = DenseStage(2, 36, 4, 12)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(60)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(60, num_classes)

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        input = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(input)))
        input = self.denseblock1(input)
        input = self.transition1(input)
        input = self.denseblock2(input)
        input = F.relu(self.norm_final(input))
        input = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(input, (1, 1))
        input = torch.flatten(input, 1)
        return self.classifier(input)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class SkipBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = make_conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn_a = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv2 = make_conv3(planes, planes)
        self.bn_b = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        shortcut_out = x

        y = self.conv1(x)
        y = self.bn_a(y)
        y = F.hardswish(y)
        y = self.conv2(y)
        y = self.bn_b(y)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            shortcut_out = self.shortcut(x)

        y += shortcut_out
        y = F.hardswish(y)
        return y


class TinyResNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, block, num_classes=1000):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = 24
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, self.inplanes, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(self.inplanes)
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.stage1 = self._make_layer(block, 24, 1)
        self.stage2 = self._make_layer(block, 48, 1, stride=2)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(48 * block.expansion, num_classes)

    def _make_layer(self, block, planes, blocks, stride=1):
        downsample = None
        if stride != 1 or self.inplanes != planes * block.expansion:
            downsample = nn.Sequential(
                make_conv1(self.inplanes, planes * block.expansion, stride),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * block.expansion),
            )
        layers = [block(self.inplanes, planes, stride, downsample)]
        self.inplanes = planes * block.expansion
        for _ in range(1, blocks):
            layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes))
        return nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv1(x)
        x = self.bn1(x)
        x = F.hardswish(x)
        x = self.maxpool(x)
        x = self.stage1(x)
        x = self.stage2(x)
        x = self.avgpool(x)
        x = x.flatten(1)
        x = self.fc(x)
        return x

    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLP(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        h = self.ln_1(tensor)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + tensor

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y


class PatchTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_proj = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=4, stride=4)
        self.pos_embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 16, 16))
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            EncoderBlock(2, 16, 32),
            EncoderBlock(2, 16, 32),
            EncoderBlock(2, 16, 32),
        )
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(16, eps=1e-6)
        self.head = nn.Linear(16, num_classes)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv_proj(tensor)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + self.pos_embedding
        x = self.encoder(x)
        x = self.ln(x)
        x = x.mean(dim=1)
        return self.head(x)

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class FireModule(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super(FireModule, self).__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.reduce = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_a = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_b = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.squeeze_activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.expand1x1_activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.expand3x3_activation = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, input):
        input = self.squeeze_activation(self.reduce(input))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.expand1x1_activation(self.expand_a(input)), self.expand3x3_activation(self.expand_b(input))], 1
        )


class TinySqueezeNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super(TinySqueezeNet, self).__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            FireModule(32, 8, 32, 32),
            FireModule(64, 8, 32, 32),
            FireModule(64, 16, 64, 64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            FireModule(128, 16, 64, 64),
            FireModule(128, 32, 128, 128),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            FireModule(256, 32, 128, 128),
            FireModule(256, 64, 256, 256),
        )
        final_conv = nn.Conv2d(512, num_classes, kernel_size=1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5), final_conv, nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        )

    def forward(self, input):
        input = self.features(input)
        input = self.classifier(input)
        return torch.flatten(input, 1)

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut=None, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv1 = make_conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv2 = make_conv3(planes, planes)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, inp):
        identity = inp

        y = self.conv1(inp)
        y = self.norm1(y)
        y = torch.relu(y)
        y = self.conv2(y)
        y = self.norm2(y)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            identity = self.shortcut(inp)

        y += identity
        y = F.relu(y, inplace=True)
        return y


class Backbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, block, num_classes=1000):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = 16
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, self.inplanes, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(self.inplanes)
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.block1 = self._make_layer(block, 16, 3)
        self.block2 = self._make_layer(block, 32, 2, stride=2)
        self.block3 = self._make_layer(block, 64, 3, stride=2)
        self.block4 = self._make_layer(block, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(128 * block.expansion, num_classes)

    def _make_layer(self, block, planes, blocks, stride=1):
        downsample = None
        if stride != 1 or self.inplanes != planes * block.expansion:
            downsample = nn.Sequential(
                make_conv1(self.inplanes, planes * block.expansion, stride),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * block.expansion),
            )
        layers = [block(self.inplanes, planes, stride, downsample)]
        self.inplanes = planes * block.expansion
        for _ in range(1, blocks):
            layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes))
        return nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, inp):
        inp = self.conv1(inp)
        inp = self.bn1(inp)
        inp = F.relu(inp, inplace=True)
        inp = self.maxpool(inp)
        inp = self.block1(inp)
        inp = self.block2(inp)
        inp = self.block3(inp)
        inp = self.block4(inp)
        inp = self.avgpool(inp)
        inp = inp.view(inp.size(0), -1)
        inp = self.fc(inp)
        return inp

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class DenseUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        out = self.conv1(torch.relu(self.norm1(tensor)))
        out = self.conv2(F.relu(self.norm2(out), inplace=True))
        return out


class _DenseBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseUnit(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, tensor):
        feats_list = [tensor]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(feats_list, 1))
            feats_list.append(new)
        return torch.cat(feats_list, 1)


class TinyDenseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(16)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = _DenseBlock(3, 16, 4, 12)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(52), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(52, 26, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = _DenseBlock(4, 26, 4, 12)
        self.transition2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(74), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(74, 37, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock3 = _DenseBlock(2, 37, 4, 12)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(61)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(61, num_classes)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        tensor = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(tensor)))
        tensor = self.denseblock1(tensor)
        tensor = self.transition1(tensor)
        tensor = self.denseblock2(tensor)
        tensor = self.transition2(tensor)
        tensor = self.denseblock3(tensor)
        tensor = F.relu(self.norm_final(tensor))
        tensor = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(tensor, (1, 1))
        tensor = torch.flatten(tensor, 1)
        return self.classifier(tensor)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class MLPBlock(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class TransformerLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLPBlock(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        torch._assert(x.dim() == 3, f"Expected (batch_size, seq_length, hidden_dim) got {x.shape}")
        h = self.ln_1(x)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + x

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y


class PatchTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_proj = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=4, stride=4)
        self.class_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, 16))
        self.pos_embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 65, 16))
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            TransformerLayer(2, 16, 32),
            TransformerLayer(2, 16, 32),
        )
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(16, eps=1e-6)
        self.head = nn.Linear(16, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class Bottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, skip=None, norm_layer=None):
        super(Bottleneck, self).__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv_a = make_conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_b = make_conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_c = make_conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.skip = skip
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, feats):
        identity = feats

        y = self.conv_a(feats)
        y = self.bn1(y)
        y = self.relu(y)
        y = self.conv_b(y)
        y = self.bn2(y)
        y = self.relu(y)
        y = self.conv_c(y)
        y = self.bn3(y)

        if self.skip is not None:
            identity = self.skip(feats)

        y = y + identity
        y = self.relu(y)
        return y


class TinyResNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, block, num_classes=1000):
        super(TinyResNet, self).__init__()
        self.inplanes = 16
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, self.inplanes, kernel_size=5, stride=2, padding=2, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(self.inplanes)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.stage1 = self._make_layer(block, 16, 2)
        self.stage2 = self._make_layer(block, 32, 2, stride=2)
        self.stage3 = self._make_layer(block, 64, 1, stride=2)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(64 * block.expansion, num_classes)

    def _make_layer(self, block, planes, blocks, stride=1):
        downsample = None
        if stride != 1 or self.inplanes != planes * block.expansion:
            downsample = nn.Sequential(
                make_conv1(self.inplanes, planes * block.expansion, stride),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * block.expansion),
            )
        layers = [block(self.inplanes, planes, stride, downsample)]
        self.inplanes = planes * block.expansion
        for _ in range(1, blocks):
            layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes))
        return nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.conv1(feats)
        feats = self.bn1(feats)
        feats = self.relu(feats)
        feats = self.stage1(feats)
        feats = self.stage2(feats)
        feats = self.stage3(feats)
        feats = self.avgpool(feats)
        feats = torch.flatten(feats, 1)
        feats = self.fc(feats)
        return feats

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        feats = self.conv(feats)
        feats = self.bn(feats)
        if not self.use_act:
            return feats
        return F.relu(feats)


class InvertedResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.use_res_connect = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(BasicConv2d(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(BasicConv2d(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))

        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.use_res_connect:
            return feats + self.conv(feats)
        return self.conv(feats)


class MobileNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=1000):
        super().__init__()
        input_channel = 24
        settings = [
            [1, 12, 1, 1],
            [6, 24, 3, 2],
            [3, 32, 1, 1],
            [4, 40, 3, 1],
        ]
        features = [BasicConv2d(3, input_channel, kernel_size=3, stride=2)]
        for t, c, n, s in settings:
            for i in range(n):
                stride = s if i == 0 else 1
                features.append(InvertedResidual(input_channel, c, stride, expand_ratio=t))
                input_channel = c
        features.append(BasicConv2d(input_channel, 128, kernel_size=1))
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*features)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        feats = self.features(feats)
        feats = feats.mean([2, 3])
        feats = self.classifier(feats)
        return feats

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(F.relu6(self.norm1(input), inplace=True))
        out = self.conv2(F.relu6(self.norm2(out), inplace=True))
        return out


class _DenseBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = [input]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(outputs, 1))
            outputs.append(new)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)


class DenseNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(24)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = _DenseBlock(3, 24, 2, 8)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(48), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(48, 24, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = _DenseBlock(2, 24, 2, 8)
        self.transition2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(40), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(40, 20, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock3 = _DenseBlock(2, 20, 2, 8)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(36)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(36, num_classes)

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        input = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(input)))
        input = self.denseblock1(input)
        input = self.transition1(input)
        input = self.denseblock2(input)
        input = self.transition2(input)
        input = self.denseblock3(input)
        input = F.relu(self.norm_final(input))
        input = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(input, (1, 1))
        input = torch.flatten(input, 1)
        return self.classifier(input)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def shuffle_channels(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = feats.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(feats), self.branch2(feats)), dim=1)
        out = shuffle_channels(out, 2)
        return out


class ShuffleBackbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=1000):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(16), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        input_channels = 16
        seq = [ShuffleBlock(input_channels, 32, 2)]
        for _ in range(0):
            seq.append(ShuffleBlock(32, 32, 1))
        self.stage2 = nn.Sequential(*seq)
        input_channels = 32
        seq = [ShuffleBlock(input_channels, 64, 2)]
        for _ in range(0):
            seq.append(ShuffleBlock(64, 64, 1))
        self.stage3 = nn.Sequential(*seq)
        input_channels = 64
        seq = [ShuffleBlock(input_channels, 128, 2)]
        for _ in range(1):
            seq.append(ShuffleBlock(128, 128, 1))
        self.stage4 = nn.Sequential(*seq)
        input_channels = 128
        self.conv5 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 256, 1, 1, 0, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(256), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(256, num_classes)

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        feats = self.conv1(feats)
        feats = self.maxpool(feats)
        feats = self.stage2(feats)
        feats = self.stage3(feats)
        feats = self.stage4(feats)
        feats = self.conv5(feats)
        feats = feats.mean([2, 3])
        feats = self.fc(feats)
        return feats

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class FeedForward(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class TransformerLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = FeedForward(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, feats):
        h = self.ln_1(feats)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + feats

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y


class TinyViT(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_proj = nn.Conv2d(3, 48, kernel_size=4, stride=4)
        self.pos_embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 16, 48))
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            TransformerLayer(2, 48, 96),
            TransformerLayer(2, 48, 96),
            TransformerLayer(2, 48, 96),
        )
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(48, eps=1e-6)
        self.head = nn.Linear(48, num_classes)

    def forward(self, feats):
        n, c, h, w = feats.shape
        torch._assert(h == 16, f"Wrong image height! Expected 16 but got {h}!")
        torch._assert(w == 16, f"Wrong image width! Expected 16 but got {w}!")
        x = self.conv_proj(feats)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + self.pos_embedding
        x = self.encoder(x)
        x = self.ln(x)
        x = x.mean(dim=1)
        return self.head(x)

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class ConvUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super(ConvUnit, self).__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.act = nn.SiLU(inplace=True) if act else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.conv(feats)
        feats = self.bn(feats)
        return self.act(feats)


class SqueezeExcitation(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super(SqueezeExcitation, self).__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, feats):
        scale = self.avgpool(feats)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * feats


class InvertedBottleneck(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False, norm_layer=None):
        super(InvertedBottleneck, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.use_residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(ConvUnit(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvUnit(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=5, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SqueezeExcitation(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, feats):
        if self.use_residual:
            return feats + self.conv(feats)
        return self.conv(feats)


class TinyMobileNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super(TinyMobileNet, self).__init__()
        input_channel = 24
        settings = [
            [1, 12, 1, 1, True],
            [3, 20, 2, 1, False],
            [3, 20, 1, 1, False],
            [3, 40, 2, 2, False],
            [6, 48, 2, 2, True],
        ]
        features = [ConvUnit(3, input_channel, kernel_size=3, stride=2)]
        for t, c, n, s, se in settings:
            for i in range(n):
                stride = s if i == 0 else 1
                features.append(InvertedBottleneck(input_channel, c, stride, expand_ratio=t, use_se=se))
                input_channel = c
        features.append(ConvUnit(input_channel, 128, kernel_size=1))
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*features)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.features(feats)
        feats = nn.functional.adaptive_avg_pool2d(feats, (1, 1))
        feats = torch.flatten(feats, 1)
        feats = self.classifier(feats)
        return feats

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class Fire(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.reduce = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_a = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_b = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        input = self.act(self.reduce(input))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.act(self.expand_a(input)), self.act(self.expand_b(input))], 1
        )


class TinySqueezeNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(32, 8, 32, 32),
            Fire(64, 8, 32, 32),
            Fire(64, 16, 64, 64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(128, 16, 64, 64),
            Fire(128, 32, 128, 128),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(256, 32, 128, 128),
            Fire(256, 64, 256, 256),
        )
        final_conv = nn.Conv2d(512, num_classes, kernel_size=1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5), final_conv, nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        )

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        input = self.features(input)
        input = self.classifier(input)
        return torch.flatten(input, 1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Fire(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.squeeze = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand1x1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand3x3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, input):
        input = self.act(self.squeeze(input))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.act(self.expand1x1(input)), self.act(self.expand3x3(input))], 1
        )


class FireNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(32, 16, 64, 64),
            Fire(128, 16, 64, 64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(128, 32, 128, 128),
            Fire(256, 32, 128, 128),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(256, 64, 256, 256),
        )
        final_conv = nn.Conv2d(512, num_classes, kernel_size=1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5), final_conv, nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        )

    def forward(self, input):
        input = self.features(input)
        input = self.classifier(input)
        return torch.flatten(input, 1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.act = nn.ReLU(inplace=True) if act else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, inp):
        inp = self.conv(inp)
        inp = self.bn(inp)
        return self.act(inp)


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = BasicConv2d(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 7))
        self.branch2_3a = BasicConv2d(ch2 * 2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch2_3b = BasicConv2d(ch2 * 2, ch2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch3_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = BasicConv2d(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=3)
        self.branch3_3a = BasicConv2d(ch3 * 2, ch3, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch3_3b = BasicConv2d(ch3 * 2, ch3, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = BasicConv2d(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, inp):
        y1 = self.branch1(inp)
        y2 = self.branch2_1(inp)
        y2 = self.branch2_2(y2)
        y2 = [
            self.branch2_3a(y2),
            self.branch2_3b(y2),
        ]
        y2 = torch.cat(y2, 1)
        y3 = self.branch3_1(inp)
        y3 = self.branch3_2(y3)
        y3 = [
            self.branch3_3a(y3),
            self.branch3_3b(y3),
        ]
        y3 = torch.cat(y3, 1)
        bp = self.pool(inp)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([y1, y2, y3, bp], dim=1)


class MixedNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem1 = BasicConv2d(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        self.stem2 = BasicConv2d(24, 24, kernel_size=3)
        self.mixed_1 = InceptionBlock(24, 24, 24, 24, 16)
        self.mixed_2 = InceptionBlock(136, 16, 12, 24, 16)
        self.mixed_3 = InceptionBlock(104, 16, 16, 16, 8)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(p=0.5)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(88, num_classes)

    def forward(self, inp):
        inp = self.stem1(inp)
        inp = self.stem2(inp)
        inp = self.mixed_1(inp)
        inp = self.mixed_2(inp)
        inp = self.mixed_3(inp)
        inp = self.avgpool(inp)
        inp = torch.flatten(inp, 1)
        inp = self.dropout(inp)
        inp = self.fc(inp)
        return inp

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super(ConvUnit, self).__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act
        self.act = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, input):
        input = self.conv(input)
        input = self.bn(input)
        if self.use_act:
            input = self.act(input)
        return input


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super(SELayer, self).__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, input):
        scale = self.avgpool(input)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * input


class InvertedBottleneck(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False):
        super(InvertedBottleneck, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.has_skip = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(ConvUnit(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvUnit(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SELayer(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, input):
        if self.has_skip:
            return input + self.conv(input)
        return self.conv(input)


class MobileNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super(MobileNetLike, self).__init__()
        input_channel = 16
        settings = [
            [1, 8, 1, 1, False],
            [6, 8, 2, 1, True],
            [3, 16, 1, 2, True],
            [3, 32, 2, 2, False],
            [4, 64, 1, 1, False],
        ]
        features = [ConvUnit(3, input_channel, kernel_size=3, stride=2)]
        for t, c, n, s, se in settings:
            for i in range(n):
                stride = s if i == 0 else 1
                features.append(InvertedBottleneck(input_channel, c, stride, expand_ratio=t, use_se=se))
                input_channel = c
        features.append(ConvUnit(input_channel, 64, kernel_size=1))
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*features)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, input):
        input = self.features(input)
        input = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(input, 1)
        input = torch.flatten(input, 1)
        input = self.classifier(input)
        return input


network = MobileNetLike()

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Fire(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.squeeze = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand1x1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand3x3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.squeeze_activation = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.expand1x1_activation = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.expand3x3_activation = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        tensor = self.squeeze_activation(self.squeeze(tensor))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.expand1x1_activation(self.expand1x1(tensor)), self.expand3x3_activation(self.expand3x3(tensor))], 1
        )


class SqueezeNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(32, 16, 64, 64),
            Fire(128, 16, 64, 64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(128, 32, 128, 128),
            Fire(256, 32, 128, 128),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(256, 64, 256, 256),
        )
        final_conv = nn.Conv2d(512, num_classes, kernel_size=1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5), final_conv, nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        )

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        tensor = self.features(tensor)
        tensor = self.classifier(tensor)
        return torch.flatten(tensor, 1)
